messages:
sara: heads-up — saw a weird spike in staging billing traces after a reconnect test. looks like a resumed stream re-sent the first toolcall chunk and we charged both.
kevin: ugh. repro steps?
sara: repro: start stream -> send toolcall (body A) -> network drop -> client reconnects with resume token -> server accepts and client re-sends body A. logs show two provisional charges; one never got reconciled when session-confirm came in.
juna: do we have a resume window check? we currently accept resume if last_seq <= session.last_ack + 1 (opaque window). maybe the compare is too permissive.
kevin: hmm. the core issue is ledger attribution. provisional credits are created on any inbound toolcall chunk; when resume happens we try to dedupe by prefix hash but that hash is only computed for confirmed messages, not provisional ones.
matt: can we add a resume_id tag to provisional ledger rows so we can reconcile on resume? then console can flip provisional->confirmed atomically.
sara: that'd help. also the console currently shows only final confirmed tokens per request; operators get confused when provisional blips appear as temporary spikes in tenant billing charts.
ops-bot: deploy-notify: canary rollout started for account-metadata fix (id: canary/2026-03-20/02)
kevin: proposal: on accept-resume, server computes a stable prefix_digest = sha256(session_id || prefix_bytes) and upserts ledger rows with (prefix_digest, resume_id, provisional=true). on confirmation path, `provisional` -> `confirmed` only if resume_id matches.
sara: pseudo-query I sketched:
```
-- mark matching provisional rows as confirmed on resume accept
UPDATE ledger
SET status = 'confirmed', resume_id = $resume_id
WHERE prefix_digest = $digest AND session_id = $session_id AND status = 'provisional';
```
juna: edge: what about partial truncation where client truncates last N tokens on resume? digest won't match and we'll leave old provisional row. need to attach `overlap_len` and charge the delta.
matt: console UX: expose a small timeline per-request with three buckets: provisional, reconciled, final. tooltip: explain resume windows and potential provisional credits and link to docs.
kevin: telemetry: add a span tag `resume_policy=opaque-window-v2` and `prefix_digest` (hashed) so we can group traces without leaking content.
sara: test plan: create unit test for: double-send exact-prefix -> ledger dedupe; partial-truncate -> ledger delta; mismatched-resume -> keep provisional separate and create delta charge. also run load test for 10k resuming sessions.
juna: SGTM. I'll draft the PR for ledger schema change and a small migration to backfill `prefix_digest=null` -> compute from archived payloads where available.
kevin: one more: add a dashboard card in console for provisional-credit rate (last 24h) with an alert if >0.5% of tokens to catch noisy clients early.
sara: nice. I'll open tickets for PR + console card + telemetry. thanks.
ops-bot: ticket created: PLAT-1347 (ledger-resume-dedupe), PLAT-1348 (console-provisional-ux), PLAT-1349 (telemetry-resume-tags) :thumbsup:
